page.notes: Transcribed from a low-resolution scan; the small italic numerals and abbreviations are the least certain parts. Doubtful readings include "intelligetia", "inuocatio simulata", "cosmetur", "admunentum", "caeca", "safutis", "admihilum", "perus", "Ifmaci", "Israelis disperssionis", "Iosephi vt" and "prium". Printed spellings such as "Ifaac", "Ifmaci" and "Iob" are kept as printed. The left edge strip belongs to the neighbouring page and is not transcribed. Dash and hyphen marks are not reproduced where the printer's line breaks do not show a clear hyphen.
